note: State-owned destination resort on Rathbun Lake (distinct from the separate Honey Creek State Park on the same lake). Paved RV loop in the open by the resort road; no tents, 1 vehicle per site. Lodge, cabins, golf, indoor waterpark on site. --Claude
summary: New rate $35-45 + mandatory $25 resort fee (=$60+), 50 amp full hookups, pull-through, 14-day max, operator engine. Not waterfront stands. FLAG: over the $50 gate.
flags: PRICE GATE, a human call: over $50 once the mandatory fee counts. Cheapest real RV night a 23-ft motorhome can book in any date I read: $35 Best Available + '$25 Resort Fee per night will be added to the reservation' = $60 before tax (2027-04-13, 05-11, 06-08, 07-02, 10-12 all $35; RV Park Rate up to $45 = $70).
